mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month rise in unemployment rate above 4.5% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending confidence, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals weakening demand and rising price pressures, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST declines and CPIAUCSL rises, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: During high industrial production phases (INDPRO > 105.0), a quarterly growth slowdown below 0.5% signals manufacturing weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 105.0 and INDPRO quarterly growth < 0.5%, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year rise in CPIAUCSL above 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of economic context.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS increases month-over-month, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 720,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS falls below 720,000, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous slowdown in industrial production growth (INDPRO < 0.5% q/q) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% y/y) signals stagflationary risks that cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO growth rate < 0.5% q/q and CPIAUCSL > 3.5% y/y, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases.
